authority: BC Liquor Distribution Branch (BC Cannabis Wholesale)
description: Data BC LDB Wholesale needs at product registration. Field mapping to the BCLDB Wholesale Product Catalog is in profiles/README.md.

sources.title: BCLDB Wholesale Cannabis Product Registration Guide (2026-06)

notes: Image files must be named with the unit GTIN; COSTA media objects carry the gtin so a consumer can generate the file name.
Potency ranges must match what was approved with BCLDB Category Management.
BCLDB's own Category, Subcategory and Class hierarchy is assigned by BCLDB; record it in jurisdictions[].category and .subcategory.
